answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with slashable proof-of-stake identity: before an attestor emits a fresh, nonce-bound signal certifying one agent, that agent must lock a bond. Peers compare attestation graphs to catch clones reusing keys or funding, and a caught clone forfeits its bond. Payouts weight locked stake by age, not headcount, so the lagoon of rewards cannot be drained by spawning copies, and honest work keeps the nectar. Each fake identity costs a fresh bond plus interest forgone while locked, so a Sybil raid loses money before earning any.
